verdict.rationale: Raygun explicitly supports ordering/prioritizing errors by 'users affected' and occurrence counts, which directly maps to blast-radius prioritization rather than raw event counts (raygun-docs-3). However, there's no evidence of session-level impact quantification, percentage-of-userbase metrics, or dedicated 'impact score' analytics beyond simple affected-user counts. Missing for 10: session-affected metrics, quantified blast-radius scoring/percentage-of-users, independent corroboration of this prioritization workflow in practice.
